Microsoft Corp.
Evolving AI Offering Brings E7 to
Office Range
As part of several product announcements, MSFT today
introduced an E7 SKU to its Office line-up. E7 will combine the
E5 capabilities with Copilot and Agent 365, and represents a
clear up-sell opportunity. We like this move as it harmonizes
the fragmenting Office plus Add-On landscape. 
The Office Suite is one of MSFT's largest franchises, with over 400mn users. Seat growth has
been one growth factor but upside here is limited (mostly entry level expansions), and hence
capturing greater value has been the more important driver of growth. In this respect, we like
the introduction of E7 today as it enables the continuation of MSFT's upsell strategy by bundling
more value into an offering at a higher price point. E7 should increase investors' confidence that
MSFT can maintain solid Office growth (currently around mid-teens level YoY) for longer. We also
note the launch of Wave 3 for MSFT Copilot which includes the offering of Anthropic's models
(beside OpenAI) and Claude Cowork capabilities and cements MSFT's role as a successful fast
follower of new technology.
When MSFT launched Copilot a while ago, many investors asked why it was not part of a new
SKU (E7 for example). At the time, it seemed MSFT wanted to make Copilot available to a
broader audience (not just the high-end SKU customers) and hence the separate pricing.

both see accelerated adoption via E7 SKU. Note: recent M365 price hikes already force

### 1. Office 套件的用戶基礎龐大且增長潛力轉向價值捕捉  
Office 套件是 Microsoft 最大的 franchise 之一，擁有超過 4 億用戶。座位增長的上漲空間有限（主要是入門級擴張），因此捕捉更大價值成為更重要的增長驅動因素【KB:20260313_Barclays_MSFT_Microsoft_Corp.-_Evolving_AI_Offering_Brings_E7_to_Offic.txt】。E7 SKU 的推出通過將更多價值捆綁到更高價位的產品中，實現了 Microsoft 的升級銷售戰略，增強了投資者對其維持可觀 Office 增長（目前約為 mid-teens 水平的同比增長）的信心【KB:20260313_Barclays_MSFT_Microsoft_Corp.-_Evolving_AI_Offering_Brings_E7_to_Offic.txt】。  

### 2. AI 功能的整合提升了產品附加值  
E7 SKU 結合了 E5 的功能、Copilot 和 Agent 365，代表了明顯的升級銷售機會。它統一了 Fragmenting 的 Office 加附加組件的格局，並通過整合 Copilot 和 Agent 365 等 AI 功能，提升了產品的競爭力和用戶粘性【KB:20260313_Barclays_MSFT_Microsoft_Corp.-_Evolving_AI_Offering_Brings_E7_to_Offic.txt】。  

### 3. 面臨 Azure 供應受限的挑戰時，Office 領域的穩健增長成為補償  
在 Azure 供應受限的情況下，Microsoft 通過推動 Office 領域的升級銷售（如 E7 SKU），彌補了 Azure 增長可能受到的影響。E7 SKU 不僅能帶來直接的收入增長，還能通過提升用戶付費水平和增加用戶對 Microsoft 生態系統的依賴，增強長期盈利能力【KB:20260313_Barclays_MSFT_Microsoft_Corp
